description: This file contains implementation of big integer arithmetic functions using OpenSSL's BIGNUM library, serving as a math library interface for cryptographic operations in the SRP authentication project.

methods.name: BigIntegerFromInt
methods.description: Creates a BigInteger from an unsigned int using BN_new and BN_set_word.

methods.name: BigIntegerFromBytes
methods.description: Creates a BigInteger from a byte array using BN_bin2bn.

methods.name: BigIntegerToBytes
methods.description: Converts a BigInteger to a byte array using BN_bn2bin.

methods.name: BigIntegerCmpInt
methods.description: Compares a BigInteger with an unsigned int by creating a temporary BIGNUM.

methods.name: BigIntegerAddInt
methods.description: Adds a BigInteger and an unsigned int by creating a temporary BIGNUM.

methods.name: BigIntegerMulInt
methods.description: Multiplies a BigInteger by an unsigned int using BN_mul with a temporary BIGNUM.

methods.name: BigIntegerModMul
methods.description: Performs modular multiplication of two BigIntegers.

methods.name: BigIntegerModExpInt
methods.description: Performs modular exponentiation with an unsigned int exponent.
